title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 338, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Power Cost Change to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter reading in the billing months of June, July, and Augut, 1986. The Power Cost charge refects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by The Company. Application is also made by Cambridge Electric Light Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and MPDU 347. The ruels established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 210 and 210 of the Publc Utilitiy Regulatory Policies Act of 1978. Filed June 9, 1986.
